name: A bin overflows
description: One bin (WGT-T003) fills past 90 % in zone C; the other bins are fine, so no truck round is needed, just that bin.

expected.twin: The bin's weight rises; once emptied it returns to the liner residue.
expected.brain: Pollution: one bin above 90 %: send a crew to empty it (WGT-T003 empty); no garbage-truck round for a single bin.

how_to_verify: Map: the bin's zone highlighted, the Twin frames WGT-T003 while it fills; the empty command in the timeline; logs/PO02-*.jsonl. On the live Twin the scenario fills WGT-T003 itself (WGT-T003 fill 62 → 96 %, device API) and the Brain empties it once it passes 90 %.
trigger: python scenarios/run.py PO02   (or the Run button on the control center; --server to play it on the running Brain, live or mock)
